product.name: Monoprice 5-in-1 USB-C to 4K@60Hz HDMI Display Adapter and USB Hub
product.description: Monoprice™5‑in‑1 USB‑C® to 4K HDMI® Display Adapter and USB HubSupports USB Type‑C® and Thunderbolt™ 3 hosts with DisplayPort Alt Mode supportThe Monoprice™ 5‑in‑1 USB‑C® to 4K HDMI® Display and USB Hub Adapter allows you to greatly expand the capabilities of your USB Type‑C® or Thunderbolt™ 3 host computer. On systems that support DisplayPort® 1.4 Alt Mode, you can add a 4K@60Hz HDMI display to expand your system's desktop area or to mirror the main host screen. For systems that support DP 1.2 Alt Mode, it supports up to 4K@30Hz resolution.It includes three USB 3.0 Type‑A ports and a single USB Type‑C port, with support for 5Gbps data transfer rates, which is more than 10 times faster than USB 2.0 standard. One of the Type‑A ports can provide 1.5A/7.5W of charging power, while the USB Type‑C port provides up to 100W of Power Delivery (PD) 3.0 to keep your laptop fully charged. This plug 'n' play adapter requires no external drivers or special configuration. Just plug it in and use it. It is compatible with USB Type‑C® or Thunderbolt™ 3 host systems running the Windows® and macOS® operating systems, with support for DisplayPort Alt mode.Adds a single 4K@60Hz HDMI® display for systems that support DP 1.4 Alt ModeSupports up to 4K@30Hz resolution on systems that support DP 1.2 Alt ModeOne USB Type‑C® with up to 100W Power Delivery 3.0 or 5Gbps data transfer rateThree USB Type‑A ports with up to 5Gbps data transfer rateOne Type‑A port also provides up to 1.5A/7.5W charging powerCompatible with the Windows® and macOS® operating systemsSupports USB Type‑C® and Thunderbolt™ 3 hosts MASSIVE EXPANSIONThis hub adapter features three USB 3.0 Type‑A and one Type‑C® ports, so you can add extra peripherals, such as a keyboard, mouse, or an external drive. One of the Type‑A ports provides up to 1.5A/7.5W charging power, while the Type‑C port can provide up to 100W Power Delivery. HIGH RESOLUTION 4K DISPLAYOn systems with support for DisplayPort® 1.4 Alt Mode, you can add a single HDMI® display at resolutions up to 4K@60Hz. For systems that support DP 1.2 Alt Mode, the maximum resolution is limited to 4K@30Hz. FAST DATA TRANSFERSThe USB Type‑A ports support the USB 3.0 standard, which allows them to transfer data at up to 5Gbps, more than 10 times faster than the older USB 2.0 standard. The Type‑C® port can also transfer at up to 5Gbps, when not providing Power Delivery. USB POWER DELIVERYThe USB Type‑C® port charges through to your laptop and other connected devices with up to 100W Power Deliver 3.0 fast charging. The Fast Role Swap feature makes the host the power source and keeps everything going, if the power supply is accidentally disconnected. EASE OF USEThis plug 'n' play adapter requires no external drivers or special configuration.
